gloss: to replace; to substitute; to swap out

definitions.gloss: to replace; to substitute; to swap out
definitions.explanation: To exchange one thing for another, especially when updating or correcting something.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{新|あたら}しいものに{差|さ}し{替|か}える。
examples.english: Replace the photo with a new one.

examples.japanese: {資料|しりょう}の{一部|いちぶ}を{差|さ}し{替|か}えて{再提出|さいていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: I replaced part of the document and resubmitted it.

examples.japanese: {出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}を{急遽|きゅうきょ}{差|さ}し{替|か}えることになった。
examples.english: We had to suddenly replace the performer.

notes:
{差|さ}し{替|か}える is commonly used in business and media contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真|しゃしん}を{差|さ}し{替|か}える: to replace a photo
- {資料|しりょう}を{差|さ}し{替|か}える: to replace documents
- {人員|じんいん}を{差|さ}し{替|か}える: to replace personnel
- {差|さ}し{替|か}え{版|ばん}: replacement version

RELATED WORDS:
- {入|い}れ{替|か}える: to switch, to interchange
- {取|と}り{替|か}える: to exchange, to replace
- {交換|こうかん}する: to exchange
